description.description: The sequence follows an elderly man and two individuals in military-style tactical gear as they confront a young man through a sliding window and pull him out onto a porch. Initially, the elderly man and tactical responder are seen tugging at the young man's shirt inside the frame of the window. The young man appears frightened and stunned. As they continue to pull, the elderly man shouts instructions to 'come on out' and they eventually leverage the young man through the window and onto his feet on the porch walkway.
